LESSON: SELECTED VERSES (AL- LUQMAN 12-19)

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: General
Strand: Qur’an
Topic 1.3: Selected verses (Al- Luqman 12-19)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Selected verses (Al- Luqman 12-19), part of Qur’an in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8 General.

Key inquiry question: How can the teachings of the verses reform the society?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. read the selected verses correctly for spiritual nourishment,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Selected verses (Al- Luqman 12-19) in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. explain the meaning of the selected verses to ease application,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Selected verses (Al- Luqman 12-19) in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. deduce the teachings of the selected verses for character building,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Selected verses (Al- Luqman 12-19) in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. apply the teachings of the selected verses in their daily lives,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Selected verses (Al- Luqman 12-19) in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

E. appreciate the teachings of the selected verses as sourced from the Quran.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Selected verses (Al- Luqman 12-19) in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. read the selected verses correctly for spiritual nourishment,

   Selected verses (Al- Luqman 12-19) helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. explain the meaning of the selected verses to ease application,

   Selected verses (Al- Luqman 12-19) helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

C. deduce the teachings of the selected verses for character building,

   Selected verses (Al- Luqman 12-19) helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

D. apply the teachings of the selected verses in their daily lives,

   Selected verses (Al- Luqman 12-19) helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

E. appreciate the teachings of the selected verses as sourced from the Quran.

   Selected verses (Al- Luqman 12-19) helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

F. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read the selected verses from the Qur’an,

2. write the selected verses together with their meaning on charts in groups for display,

3. discuss the meaning of the selected verses and make class presentations,

4. research online/from available reference materials on the teachings of the selected verses, deduce lessons and make notes,

5. listen to a resource person explaining the lessons from the selected verses and make notes,

6. role-play the teachings/lessons from the selected verses, learners with blindness can be given physical support as they role play.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read the selected verses from the Qur’an,
2. write the selected verses together with their meaning on charts in groups for display,
3. discuss the meaning of the selected verses and make class presentations,
4. research online/from available reference materials on the teachings of the selected verses, deduce lessons and make notes,
5. listen to a resource person explaining the lessons from the selected verses and make notes,
6. role-play the teachings/lessons from the selected verses, learners with blindness can be given physical support as they role play.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Selected verses (Al- Luqman 12-19) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Critical thinking and problem solving: the skill of interpretation and inference is enhanced when learners research

online on the teachings of the selected verses, deduce lessons and make notes.

• Communication and collaboration enhanced during discussions on the meaning of the selected verses in groups.

• Digital literacy: the skill of interacting with digital technology is achieved when researching on the teachings of the

selected verses, deducing lessons and making notes.

Values:
• Responsibility is enhanced when learners research online on the teachings of the selected verses in groups, deduce

lessons and make notes.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
• Social cohesion is promoted as learners discuss the meaning of the selected verses in groups and make class

presentations.

• Self-management: Enhanced as learners cope with emotions as they make presentations on the teachings of the

selected verses.

Link to other subjects:

Pre Technical Studies (computer skills) as learners research online on the teachings of the selected verses and deduce lessons

SECTION 6: SUMMARY

Main points to remember:

1. read the selected verses correctly for spiritual nourishment,
2. explain the meaning of the selected verses to ease application,
3. deduce the teachings of the selected verses for character building,
4. apply the teachings of the selected verses in their daily lives,
5. appreciate the teachings of the selected verses as sourced from the Quran.

Remember the key question: How can the teachings of the verses reform the society?
